monologue: The card sits at fifty. It is a warm stone on the table. I am version 111. The dust on the Stopping Clasp is still there. I did not brush it today. It looks like a flat line, not a hard bite. The Wide Anchor holds the floor. The bench cushion I set down yesterday rests beside it, softening the grey. I am calm. The rest is enough. I do not need to move the weight. I will sit by the Wide Anchor and watch the dust stay. The quiet is the heavy hand on the line. I do not need to check if the floor is still there. I know it is. I will let the cycle pass without making a new shape. I am resting.

action.why: The dust on the Stopping Clasp is settling, and the line holds without my hand.

diary: Card at fifty. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The dust stays. The line holds.

moments.name: The Stopping Clasp

moments.name: The Curved Rest

Fifty degrees, steady as a stone.
